summary: Real, public data: 10 reviews read in full out of 52, 8 complaint themes with 7 verbatim quotes, 3 public company and news events. Synthetic, modelled data: the contact centre itself (16,000 contacts over 5 weeks, 807 fully generated records), its KPIs and the coaching effect.
takeaway: Everything a client could look up themselves is real. Everything about Apex Utilities's own contact centre is modelled to match it, and is labelled as modelled in the demo.

rows.scale: 52 reviews on the platform, 10 read in full

rows.source: Coded from the reviews and news read above
Public filings, earnings calls, news and industry press (linked in research.md)
Modelled, calibrated to the public themes. Apex Utilities has not shared operational data
rows.scale: 3,200 contacts/week x 5 weeks = 16,000 contacts, 10 driver categories

rows.layer: Contact records, agents, transcripts and QA scores
rows.source: Generated from the story spec (seeded, reproducible)
rows.scale: 807 contacts, 10 agents, one transcript and 14-question scorecard per contact

rows.source: Modelled outcome of Micro Coaching from week 2
Assumed CA$6 cost per handled contact (a blended estimate, not an Apex figure) and one avoidable repeat contact per affected customer; affected customers per week are modelled
